items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: And I played again with a fella, Joe Petit, Ambrose.

ctx.x: He played trumpet, baritone, he played all of them. Gus Madcat.

Baritone, trumpet, the peck horn, and the fella called White used to play in the band. And Johnny Nelson, all those was old time musicians. So he didn't know sugar. Well that little band, we kept that band up for a long time, that was six pieces. I gave him that little band up with Gilbert, named Rudolph. And I played again with a fella, Joe Petit, Ambrose. Joe Petit played Valder. Oh yeah.

He played tramo and played from there. I made a little record of him one time in his last days. He was quite deaf, he couldn't hardly hear what he was playing. But at least we had him on record so we could hear him play a little.
